Core Product Lines & Categories
Cleaning Verification & Monitoring:
Residue tests, flush tests, and indicator strips.
Cleaning Chemistries & Instrument Care:
Enzymatic detergents, lubricants, and rust removers.
Sterilization & Packaging:
Sterilization wraps, pouches, containers, and racks.
Protective Equipment (PPE):
Cool Aids cooling vests, caps, and PPE accessories.
Storage & Organization:
Instrument trays, basin sets, and wire storage systems.
Labeling & Security:
Tamper-evident seals, indicators, and logistical tags.
